title: VoiceNodeRegistration
description: etcd value at `/discordy/voice/nodes/<region>/<node_id>` (10 s lease, refreshed every 3 s).

control_ip.description: Optional private IPv4 address for node-affine internal control. It is never derived from ws_url and requires control_port and registration_lease.

registration_lease.description: Decimal identity of this registration's current etcd lease; stale control commands must be rejected.

probe_required.description: When true, new allocation requires a fresh healthy probe record for this registration's etcd lease. Omitted/false preserves legacy rollout behavior; an explicit matching unhealthy result or manual blacklist still excludes the node.
